description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC controller named ShopContentController that handles HTTP requests for displaying content pages in an online shop. The controller retrieves content descriptions based on URL-friendly identifiers, prepares page metadata, and returns the name of the view template to render.

classes.name: ShopContentController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller responsible for handling requests to display shop content pages based on a friendly URL.

methods.name: displayContent
methods.description: Handles HTTP requests to display content pages; retrieves content description by URL, sets page metadata, and returns the view template name.
